Code of Conduct

Create a respectful, safe, and professional business ecosystem.

Our commitment

Every participant, speaker, partner, volunteer, and staff member deserves an inclusive and respectful forum experience.

Expected behavior

Communicate with professionalism, protect participant data, ask permission before recording, and follow all staff guidance and venue rules.

Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, intimidation, fraud, misuse of participant information, identity theft, and non-consensual sharing of codes or credentials are prohibited.

Enforcement

Violations may lead to warning, removal from event activities, account suspension, registration cancellation, or referral to authorities.
